title: the panel's page that asks for a password reset link, contract version 1
description: The props of the page that asks for a password reset link (PRD 5.16), Auth/ForgotPassword in js/panel. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Panel\Domain\Dto\ForgotPasswordPage, and the generated codec writes its canonical JSON: keys sorted, no whitespace.

action.description: The address the form posts to.

login.description: The address of the login page.

minutes.description: How many minutes a link works.

refusals.description: The catalog code of the refusal of the request just posted, under the field it is about; null where there is none.

requested.description: Whether a request for a link was taken just now. The answer is the same whether an account has the email or not.

refusals.description: The refusals of a request for a link, by the field they are about.

email.description: The refusal about the email, validation_required for an email left empty, or null.
